description: Exact original source IDs, selected native crops and checksums for the 349 annotated fields that supplied 967 whole-group fastPLS training examples. This manifest does not contain model weights or full-resolution images.

ontology.interpretation: Broad tissue roles; retain every original dataset label alongside the mapping. Subtypes are collapsed only to a valid broader tissue role, not asserted equivalent at subtype level.

excluded.rest: Heterogeneous residual category with no shared tissue semantics.
excluded.other: Heterogeneous residual category with no shared tissue semantics.
excluded.automatically detected non-tumor tissue: Automatic background complement is not an expert tissue-type annotation.
excluded.non-cancer background (not expert stroma: Broad non-cancer complement must not be taught as stroma or a particular normal tissue.
excluded.non-epithelial target (not expert stroma: Broad complement does not define a particular tissue role.
excluded.angioinvasion: Relational tumor-in-vessel annotation; not equivalent to either ordinary tumor or vessel alone. Preserve for a future multilabel task.

qualifications: Tumor maps preserve the source subtype as metadata; this task does not predict Gleason grade or invasiveness.
Inflamed and lymphoid stroma are grouped at the immune-rich stromal role only; source-specific definitions remain available.
Necrosis/debris, cartilage/bone and mucus/plasma/fluids are provider aggregate categories; no finer component identity is inferred.
These mappings require pathology review before clinical or manuscript claims of semantic equivalence.
